reviews.evidence: Ships a Galgame conversation stage plus drag/property/layer editing, preset export/reset, one screenshot, and unit/build-freshness/Playwright checks.
reviews.concern: Operational guidance beyond opening and editing the view is thin, and only one explicit scenario and one visual result are shown.

reviews.evidence: Covers metering, persistent billing, multi-range statistics, balance and peak/off-peak state, alerts, WeChat delivery, guarded updates, APIs, configuration, and troubleshooting; it shows several distinct UI/notification states.
reviews.concern: The README mostly presents features and states rather than several explicit user scenarios or worked outcomes.

reviews.evidence: Defines an end-to-end workspace-sandbox approval mode with classification, exact deletion rules, one-shot widening, sub-agent inheritance, localization, configuration, and detailed fail-closed boundaries.
reviews.concern: There is no concrete decision transcript or meaningful UI/output demonstration beyond textual behavior descriptions.

reviews.evidence: Provides a broad memory tool surface, ten-source import with deduplication, settings management, graph recall, review/forget policy, server keep-alive, hot reload, detailed settings, and one substantive settings-page screenshot.
reviews.concern: Actual recall/import outputs are not shown, and validation is described mainly through test commands and one conditional e2e note.

reviews.evidence: Ships snapshot/undo/redo, message-level rollback, diffs, encrypted export/import, safe mode, crash diagnosis and repair, doctor/GC, in-app and offline WebUI/GUI/CLI paths, rich screenshots, platform matrices, limits, and extensive test evidence.
reviews.concern: The rescue scenarios are numerous and concrete but are quick-reference cases rather than multiple detailed case studies with measured outcomes.

reviews.evidence: Its own shipped value is a large categorized, linked, one-line-description catalog with a table of contents and a concise contribution format.
reviews.concern: The README provides no native search, verification, scoring, or quality workflow; the pictured registry and all linked-plugin capabilities are external and earn no catalog credit.

reviews.evidence: Implements cross-agent trajectory collection, skill distillation/routing, team sharing, canary evolution, dashboard governance, generation, search/download/upload, SkillHub import, and detailed single/team workflows; benchmark tables and architecture diagrams provide concrete results.
reviews.concern: The demonstrations emphasize diagrams and aggregate benchmarks rather than representative generated skills, dashboard states, or end-to-end case outcomes.

reviews.evidence: Ships Russian text humanization and audit paths, marker and soft-signal scans, source checks, CLI/agent/DSH delivery, a reusable CI gate, a worked before/after, published corpus results, false-positive boundaries, security limits, compatibility facts, and extensive validation gates.
reviews.concern: The many patterns expand one core text-review domain; they do not by themselves justify the maximum capability anchor.

reviews.evidence: Offers eight themes, layered wallpaper/accent controls, theme-pack import/export/share, a local library, persistence, validation and rollback, comprehensive install/update/development paths, two explicit usage styles, and many real previews.
reviews.concern: Most demonstrations are appearance previews rather than representative theme-pack inputs, validation failures, or recovery outcomes.

reviews.evidence: Documents an import-resume-sync workflow across 18 source formats, full-context preservation, export to three agents, GUI and tool entry points, and concrete import call examples.
reviews.concern: The README defers parameters and edge cases to another document, shows no imported-session output, and gives little direct test, failure, or troubleshooting evidence.
